spools.title: Spools
spools.subtitle: Stock, storage location and remaining weight
spools.emptyBody: Register your first spool to track filament consumption automatically.
spools.needsCatalogBody: Spools are based on a filament type from the catalog. Create an entry there first.
spools.deductHint: Will be subtracted from the remaining weight.

tare.title: Tare calculator
tare.subtitle: Work out the net weight from a scale reading

spools.codeHint: Your own code on the spool — makes it findable via search.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Plan and track multi-part assemblies
projects.emptyBody: Create a project, list the parts you need and drop your .3mf files onto it.
projects.deleteBody: The parts, print plates and print history of this project will be deleted too.

fields.title: Title
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: A short note about this project

parts.title: Bill of materials
parts.subtitle: Required, printed and failed parts
parts.emptyBody: List the individual parts of your assembly with the quantity each one needs.
parts.deleteBody: The part and its counters will be removed.
parts.linkFilesHint: Enter how many copies of this part each file carries. 0 or empty means it is not on it.
parts.linkFilesEmpty: This project has no file yet. Drop a .3mf or G-code file here — the parts inside are detected as it is read.
parts.coverageHint: How many copies the linked files produce, compared with the number needed.
parts.emptyBodyImport: The quickest way is a file: drop a .3mf or G-code here and the parts are detected with their quantities and linked straight away. You can also enter them by hand below.

plates.title: Print plates
plates.subtitle: Read from .3mf or .gcode files
plates.emptyBody: Drop a .3mf file here to read print time and filament usage automatically.

dropzone.title: Drop a file here
dropzone.subtitle: or click to choose a file

plates.noFilamentData: No filament usage found in the file
plates.assignPartsHint: Define which project parts sit on this plate and in what quantity. They are then counted automatically after a print.
plates.deleteBody: The plate and its print history will be removed.
plates.parseWarning: The file could only be read partially. Please check the values.

job.title: Log a print
job.subtitle: Assign spools and record the outcome
job.assignSpoolsHint: Pick the spool actually used for each filament slot. Usage is deducted automatically after the print.
job.insufficientWarning: At least one slot does not have enough filament. You can continue anyway — that spool will be set to 0 g.
job.noSpoolsAvailable: No active spools available. Add a spool first.
job.markSuccessHint: Deduct filament and count printed parts
job.markFailedHint: Deduct filament and count as scrap
job.durationHint: Leave empty to use the estimated time.
job.historyEmptyBody: Once you log a print it will show up here.
job.deleteBody: The entry will be removed. Stock and counters already booked stay unchanged.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, data and backups
settings.themeHint: Light, dark, or follow the system.
settings.onlineHint: Off by default. PrintFlow works without the internet.
settings.onlineOffHint: No network access. Everything stays on this device.
settings.onlineOnHint: Fetch preview images from model portals and download files from links.
settings.onlineDetail: This unlocks exactly two things: fetching a project's preview image once from its model page (it then lives locally in the database), and downloading a file from a link you supply. Only MakerWorld, Printables, Thingiverse, Cults3D, MyMiniFactory and Thangs are allowed. The requests run in the app core, not in the interface — the interface itself stays cut off from the network.
settings.databaseHint: Your data lives in a SQLite file on this device.
settings.exportHint: Copies the whole database to a .db file.
settings.importHint: Replaces all existing data with the backup.
settings.importConfirmBody: All current data will be replaced by the selected file. The previous database is kept alongside as a .bak file. The app reloads afterwards.
settings.aboutBody: PrintFlow runs fully offline. No data is ever sent to external servers.

errors.dbInit: The database could not be opened.
errors.openFailed: The link could not be opened.
errors.notFoundBody: This entry does not exist (any more).

parse.unsupported: This file type is not supported.
parse.corrupt: The file could not be read — it is damaged or not a valid archive.
parse.noMetadata: No print data was found in the file. You can enter the values manually.
parse.tooLarge: The file is too large (maximum {max} MB).

errors.minAboveMax: Must not be below the minimum

toast.scheduledCount: {count, plural, one {# plate scheduled} other {# plates scheduled}}

plan.title: Print plan
plan.subtitle: Plan when each plate gets printed
plan.emptyBody: Open a project and schedule a plate — it will show up here.
plan.overdueHint: These prints are in the past and still open.
plan.overloadedHint: More than 24 hours of printing on one day
plan.deleteBody: The plate itself is kept — only the scheduling is deleted.
plan.noPlates: This project has no plates yet. Import a file first.
plan.spreadHint: Fills each day up to 24 hours of printing, then moves on.
plan.spreadPreview: {count} plates, {time} in total — spread from the chosen day.
plan.pastDate: That day is in the past — the entry will show up as overdue straight away.
plan.moveHint: Drag an entry onto another day — or use the date field to move it to any day at all.

files.title: Files
files.subtitle: Your .3mf and G-code files on disk
files.emptyBody: Pick the folder your models live in. PrintFlow scans it for .3mf and G-code files and lists them grouped by folder.
files.truncated: There are more files than shown — the list stops at the limit.
files.timedOut: The folder took too long — it is probably on a cloud or network drive. What was found in the time is listed. Picking a narrower subfolder helps.
files.noneFound: No slicer files found in this folder.
files.alreadyImportedHint: This file is already a plate in a project.
files.alreadyImportedIn: Already a plate in “{project}” — open the project
files.folderDialogFailed: The folder dialog could not be opened.

shape.title: How your library is arranged
shape.flat: Every file sits directly in the folder — there is no arrangement for me to reuse.
shape.per-model: One folder per model ({folders} folders, {perFolder} files each on average). On import I will suggest the folder name as the project name.
shape.categorised: Categories containing model folders ({categories}). On import I will suggest the model folder as the project name.
shape.mixed: Nested {depth} levels deep with no consistent pattern — I will not suggest project names.

root.title: Model folder
root.hint: Where your .3mf and G-code files live. Read on startup.
root.askBody: Tell PrintFlow once which folder holds your .3mf and G-code files. It then reads that folder itself, works out how it is arranged, and suggests matching project names on import.

portal.portalList: MakerWorld, Printables, Thingiverse, Cults3D, MyMiniFactory and Thangs

preview.title: Preview image
preview.hint: Fetched from the model page once, then stored locally.
preview.emptyBody: No image stored yet. PrintFlow can fetch it from {host} once and keep it in the database — what you see is always the local copy.
preview.noSource: This project has no source link. Add a link to the model page and the preview image can be fetched.
preview.unsupported: {host} is not one of the supported model sites.
preview.openReader: Open the page in a window and check
preview.needsHuman: The portal showed a security check. Open the page in a window once and clear it — the image is then picked up automatically.

download.title: Model files
download.body: The portals hand out their download links only to signed-in users, so PrintFlow cannot fetch the files itself — open the model page in your browser and download them there.
download.directHint: If you already have a direct link to a file, PrintFlow downloads it to a location of your choice.
download.overwriteHint: An existing file is never overwritten — pick a new name.

title.hint: Fetches the model page's title and suggests it as the project name.
title.offline: Online features are off — the page title can only be fetched once they are enabled.

offline.fetch: Online features are off, so the preview image cannot be fetched right now.
offline.refetch: Online features are off — the stored image stays visible, but a new one can only be fetched once they are enabled.
offline.download: Online features are off. Enable them first to download a file.

errors.fetchFailed: Could not fetch the preview image: {reason}
errors.fetchFailedGeneric: Could not fetch the preview image.

parts.correctCountersHint: Only changes this part's counters — no filament deducted, no history entry. Use “Log print” for an actual print.
